summary: Acco Group Holdings Limited, a Hong Kong-based corporate services provider listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, announcing via press release the launch of licensed corporate service operations in Singapore. The subsidiary, Accolade IP (SG) PTE. LTD., received a Corporate Service Provider license from ACRA, enabling corporate secretarial, compliance, and governance services across Singapore, Malaysia, and Greater China. No financial terms, stake, or transaction details were disclosed; this is an operational expansion, not a special-situation event.
